checks.name: prefill_geometry
checks.detail: One original prefill chunk; empty prefix; exact prompt IDs; full hidden capture; first predicted token must equal retained seed. Same direct target call as native DFlash prefill.

checks.name: verification_conditioning
checks.detail: Every width16 input is retained anchor plus retained15draft tokens at recorded positions. Full16posterior IDs must match before native verify commits. No draft generation is invoked.

checks.name: cache_and_stop
checks.detail: Uses actual DFlashVerifyInput.prepare_for_verify/verify; page1 tail freeing and mapping/seq_lens updates are native. Prefix lengths, unique locations, stable prior mappings, committed locations, progress and finished status are checked.

checks.name: feature_alignment
checks.detail: Auxiliary and normalized final hidden states are captured before native verifier clears hidden_states. Only first committed-progress rows survive; native capture covers prompt+response except final emitted token.

checks.name: terminal_teacher
checks.detail: Existing prepare_feedback and online_teacher append exactly one final row from full canonical context, do not use terminal logits for labels, and preserve original masks/IDs/layer bindings.

checks.name: retained_packet_parity_gate
checks.detail: Both first retained packets compare input_ids/loss_mask/auxiliary/final tensors bitwise including distinct native-row and terminal-row evidence. Failure stops before missing126reconstructions.

checks.name: no_unintended_answers
checks.detail: Isolated RPC allowlist only reconstruct/teacher/check_weights; generate operation absent. Request-level work is128prefill+4776verify+128terminal=5032targetcalls. Startup observed Python-model calls remain separately disclosed, not zero-imputed.

checks.name: retention
checks.detail: Original sources are authenticated and copied. Only new raw capture and terminal tensor copies retire after full bitwise comparison with retained prepared packet; exact paths and before/after space recorded.

checks.name: failure_accounting
checks.detail: Started/returned target calls and terminal work receipts survive failures; no automatic retry; cleanup failure marks failed and does not hide preceding error.
